properties.description:
Recorded with add_epoch because it HAPPENED: the second item of the planned increment epoch:planned-the-mechanism-reaches-the-moment (sequence 490) landed on 2026-09-14; the increment stays planned until the third walk lands. Sequence 492 places it after epoch:the-lens-reaches-the-loop-rail (491) inside that increment.

WHAT ARRIVED. The root-cause walk on the hxm_program status-deck field report, recorded as fact:root-cause-the-status-claim-was-keyed-to-nothing-and-the-catalogue-spoke-the-designs-side-not-the-askers, and the fix at its cause: the orientation skill's trigger names the act of asserting status, whoever asked and whoever the audience is; topic_report's served description carries the asker's words and names itself the first read before a status is asserted, at its prior length; a lint contract keeps the trigger clause stated. Two catalogue tests and three lint checks, each observed failing first.

WHAT DID NOT ARRIVE, deliberately: no tool call marks "about to assert status", so nothing DEMANDS the read the way record_finding demands root-cause — the served prose is the leg reflow2 can build, and its load rate is measured at 19-24 percent where nothing demands it. The three hxm ideas (reading coverage; a project-scoped status rollup, which is dec:idea-remaining-work-has-no-answer-in-the-graph's option (b); the audience-is-not-the-trigger idea, whose cheap option this delivers) stay for Anthony's word.
properties.name: ARRIVED 2026-09-14 — the status claim is the trigger: orientation fires when the agent is about to assert status to anyone, and the catalogue answers a status question in the asker's words; the second of the three walks in epoch:planned-the-mechanism-reaches-the-moment delivered
